notes.title: Blob Update
notes.notes: The blob is improved. Now it breaks apart and launches itself in different directions - presumably to live in far off lands(and hurt anything it flings into). Interaction with a certain robot will allow for those split parts to stay and grow. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38633868/179f0c4271fbedd04805312618dbe374e19eacea.png[/img]

notes.title: Graphical and behavioral update for two bugs.
notes.notes:
The painter bug and mopper bug were given a facelift. Painter bugs spread out more and the mopper bug likes to nap.
